svg.text: Support status is derived: supported ⇔ today ≤ support_end_date. It is never stored.
A release holds the components of its latest valid SBOM only (replace on upload; see Section 9).
A mandatory case gets three DEADLINE rows. Early warning and notification start pending with timers set;
the final report starts waiting until fix_available_utc is recorded, then its timer is set.
DEADLINE.status changes only on a timer firing or a submission. A submission cancels the timer.
LOG_ENTRY is append-only: no update or delete path exists. One entry per change; all data survives restart.
Stage report output = that stage's Section 5 fields as JSON, plus a missing_fields list naming every empty one.
